<a id="端点可能性丧失与返回--endpoint-opportunity-loss-and-return"></a>
# Endpoint opportunity loss and return

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> What can be had from a configuration is kept from another exactly where the other leads back to it; failing to return loses a possibility, the start itself a witness; and return belongs to the law, not to the change, which a reading that omits the configuration reached can hide.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Every configuration reachable from s is reachable from t exactly when t leads back to s; along a path from s to t, the configurations reachable from both are the same exactly when t leads back to s. t does not lead back to s exactly when some configuration reachable from s is not reachable from t; s itself is one. Witnesses: the dead end and the flip both take false to true; the flip returns from true to false and the dead end does not; read through the constant summary, every question about what the dead end reaches has the same answer from false and from true, though it cannot return.

Canonical source: [Labelled.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Labelled.lean)
